# Application fixtures

`planting.ts` is synthetic test data: nine species (one unplanted), five sites, eight seasons and sixteen records. Quantities total 370 plants: 290 resolved and 80 needing review. One record has an unknown quantity.

Names exercise macron search and some public reference locations; identifiers, quantities and history are invented. Tests need no client workbook or `docs/` files. Keep expected arithmetic explicit instead of deriving it through the query being tested.
